name: Star Realms
summary: Two-player sci-fi deckbuilding duel where players buy ships and bases to reduce opponent from 50 Authority to zero.
rules_text: Each player starts with 10 cards (8 Scouts, 2 Vipers) as deck and 50 Authority. A central Trade Deck supplies 5 face-up Trade Row cards; 10 Explorers are also available. On your turn: Main Phase - you may in any order play cards from hand for free, use their Trade and Combat and other effects, activate bases you already have in play, trigger ally abilities when another card of same faction is in play, optionally scrap cards for scrap abilities to permanently remove them, buy cards from Trade Row or Explorers using Trade pool (bought cards go to your discard), and spend Combat pool to destroy opponent bases or reduce opponent Authority. Outpost bases must be destroyed first. Discard Phase - lose leftover Trade and Combat, discard all ships in play and remaining hand. Draw Phase - draw 5, reshuffling discard when deck empty. First player draws 3 first turn, second draws 5. Game ends when Authority hits zero.
rating_reason: Two-player deckbuilding duel, hidden hands, trade deck - perfect text engine fit.
